Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus, as determined by the new American Diabetes Association guidelines, which include a fasting plasma glucose level greater than 126 mg/dl (7.0 mmol/l), or a 2-hour postload value in the oral glucose tolerance test of greater than 200 mg/dl, with confirmation by a retest
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a documented history of type 2 diabetes diagnosed at age 48, managed with metformin, and HbA1c levels consistent with diabetes diagnosis.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: For participants aged 40 years or older, history of CVD (heart attack, stroke, history of coronary revascularization, history of peripheral or carotid revascularization, or demonstrated angina)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a history of recurrent myocardial infarctions, emergency stenting, and coronary artery bypass grafting at age 55.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: For participants aged 55 years or older, a history of CVD is not required, but participant must be considered to be at high risk for experiencing a CVD event due to existing CVD, subclinical disease, or 2+ CVD risk factors
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is 58 years old, has a history of CVD, and has multiple risk factors including smoking, hypercholesterolemia, and family history of sudden cardiac death.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: HbA1c 7.5%-9% (if on more drugs) or 7.5%-11% (if on fewer drugs)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on metformin (one drug) but has HbA1c levels of 6.5%-7.2%, which is below the required 7.5%-11% range for fewer drugs.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No exclusion criteria provided in the clinical trial criteria.

Recap: Patient meets inclusion criteria for diabetes, CVD history, and high-risk profile but fails HbA1c requirement for fewer drugs.
